_rascunho: Draft translation of the Portuguese text (pt.json is the final one).

erros.desligado: This is not turned on yet.
erros.nao_encontrado: We couldn't find this, or you can't see it.
erros.invalido:dominio: Write only the server name, like mastodon.social.
erros.invalido:propria: You can't mark your own reply.
erros.so_comunidade_aberta: Only an open community can choose the bridge.
erros.generico: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

midia.aviso: Opens outside Alumia: that server will see your visit. The thumbnail here comes through Alumia.

aprovados.texto: When on, Alumia only talks to the servers on this list (and their subdomains). The others count as blocked: nothing comes in and nothing goes out. Turning it on deletes nothing; turning it off goes back to how it was. The fixed block (Threads and Bridgy Fed) still applies.
aprovados.vazia: No approved server yet. With the mode on and the list empty, Alumia talks to no one outside.

bluesky.texto: Public posts from this community would show up on Bluesky through the Bridgy Fed bridge. The bridge is off by decision of the Institute: the choice is saved, but nothing goes out until that decision changes.
bluesky.escolher: I want the bridge when it is allowed
bluesky.barrada: The bridge is off by decision of the Institute. Nothing goes to Bluesky.
bluesky.fechada: Only an open community can choose.

avisos.soSeguidos: Mentions and replies only from people I follow
avisos.soSeguidosAjuda: The others stay in the notification list; they just don't arrive as a notification on your device.

poucoUtil.marcado: You marked this as not helpful
poucoUtil.ajuda: No one sees who marked it or how many marks there are. The reply only moves down in the conversation after 3 marks from different people. It is not removed or hidden.

fio.nota: Only what you can already see appears here. Other people's replies stay in the conversation.

salvos.ajuda: The search runs only on this device: the server doesn't know what you searched for.

libras.fixar: Pin in the sign language window
libras.tirar: Remove from the sign language window
libras.ajuda: Choose who is interpreting in Libras: their video stays pinned and always visible on this device. The choice doesn't leave here.

legendas.ajuda: Made on this device by the browser's own speech recognition. Nothing is recorded or sent. They can be wrong.
legendas.semSuporte: This browser can't make captions without sending the audio out, so they don't appear here.
